messages:
emma.sales: Heads-up — NimbusBank just submitted a SIG/CAIQ (~220 questions). PDF attached in the ticket. Need security intake + owner assignment. Timeline: procurement wants answers by EOD Fri.
vikram.security: I can triage app/auth controls. Adding to the intake queue now.
tara.security: I'll cover infra/network controls and encryption questions.
emma.sales: thanks. POC kickoff next Tue so we need a solid pass by Fri. Also they mentioned BYOK/HSM preference.
luis.eng: FYI a few questions are very implementation-specific (key rotation, KMS IAM examples). Can security call out "requires engineering input" where needed?
vikram.security: yes — I'll flag those as "eng needed" and tag @luis.eng rows.
maria.legal: looping in legal for export/control and data processing clauses. For BYOK/HSM Qs we may need to redact our internal ops runbooks.
sig-bot: New intake created: SR-9834 — assigned to security intake. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SR-9834 :white_check_mark:
emma.sales: put the customer deadline and procurement contact in the ticket: procurement@nimbusbank.com, they want the CAIQ + attestations.
vikram.security: created tracker row: NimbusBank | SIG | Owners: Vikram,Tara | Due: 2026-04-03 | Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/nimbus-sig-tracker
tara.security: quick triage notes: 1) Data retention questions — medium risk (needs legal) 2) Remote debug & shell access — high risk 3) BYOK/HSM — requires KMS/HSM architecture doc from customer.
luis.eng: dropping a snippet we can reference for KMS IAM:
```
resource "google_kms_key_ring" "prod" {}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "app" {}
```
Use as a non-prod example only.
emma.sales: asked NimbusBank to confirm whether they require HSM-backed keys or KMS with BYOK. They replied: "Prefer HSM for key custody" — forwarded to this thread.
maria.legal: noted. We'll draft a limited disclosure note and mark some answers as "high level" to avoid revealing infra.
sara.custsuc: looping in CS for the POC — they may need a signed attestation before environment access.
vikram.security: uploaded draft answers to the shared drive (see tracker link). Please review: I'm marking ~12 Qs as "requires eng/legal".
tara.security: flagged 3 questions in the CAIQ as blockers for go/no-go: remote debug, external vendor access, and data residency. Asking sales to confirm acceptable mitigations.
emma.sales: will confirm mitigations with NimbusBank and update the ticket. If they need SLA language we'll escalate to AE.
vikram.security: once reviewed, I'll move the ticket to "answered - pending customer review" and capture follow-up items as Jira subtasks.
emma.sales: thanks all — status update to NimbusBank: "Answers drafted, engineering/legal follow-ups noted; expect final response by Fri" :thumbsup:
vikram.security: closing intake here and creating a focused follow-up thread for the CAIQ closeout.
